text_block_list.text: On the way to the track for training—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: One... two... step here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... That will not do, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I thought you did great just now, but is 
that still no good?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My legs are still lagging behind. I must 
be focusing too much on my upper body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall review my dancing from the basics, 
desu wa. Please take a look again another 
day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Next, please check my running form. Here I 
go, desu wa...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, huh?! What do you mean, check your 
form?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well, how was it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
How was it? It felt pretty normal, or 
rather...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I see, so my form seems to have no issues, 
desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Next, please check my demeanor while 
studying. After that, my cooking 
technique, and then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait a second?! What's with studying and 
cooking?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I have accepted an 
offer for an "in-depth coverage" feature 
in a magazine...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was informed that along with my running 
and dancing, my daily life would also be 
covered.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If there are people looking forward to the 
special feature, I do not wish to betray 
their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I see... So that's what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But if I were the reader, I wouldn't 
really be looking for a flawless McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I mean the "expectations" you're thinking 
of are different from what everyone else 
expects.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Expectation" is just another word for 
fondness, right? Nobody's gonna be 
disappointed seeing McQueen struggle with 
things she's not good at.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I bet the readers are just hoping to see 
the real, natural McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The natural me... is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, somehow hearing that makes me feel 
as though unnecessary tension has left my 
body, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Understood. I shall show them my true, 
natural self, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly. Being relaxed is best. Like 
how you stuff your face to the limit at 
all-you-can-eat sweets.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Th-That is something I cannot show them in 
the first place, desu wa!
